darpa_cadets.uuid_format: RFC-4122 textual form; case-normalized for matching
darpa_cadets.label_semantics: positive source-label membership; event-edge labels are derived only when a source or destination UUID is listed
darpa_cadets.audit_scope: file integrity, UUID syntax, counts, duplicates, and canonical hash; not independent semantic adjudication of attack involvement
darpa_cadets.semantic_caveat: The source labeling policy has been reported to include context-expanded neighboring entities; interpret these as benchmark anomaly/entity labels, not unqualified malicious-entity ground truth.
